notes: NCBI StatPearls Pulmonary Alveolar Proteinosis was reread for autoimmune PAP mechanism, decreased rather than increased surfactant clearance, anti-GM-CSF antibodies, crazy-paving CT, milky BAL, foamy macrophages, and PAS-positive material.
A 2023 PubMed Central review was reread for GM-CSF-dependent alveolar macrophage dysfunction and impaired surfactant/debris clearance.
A mechanistic PubMed Central study was reread for neutralization of GM-CSF by autoantibodies and resulting alveolar macrophage dysfunction.
The official USMLE 2026 Respiratory System outline and its introductory statement that listed diseases are examples rather than exhaustive were reread.

blueprint.competency: Medical Knowledge: Applying Foundational Science Concepts

claim_audit.core_mechanism: Autoimmune PAP is caused by neutralizing IgG anti-GM-CSF antibodies that impair alveolar macrophage function and surfactant clearance.
claim_audit.clearance_not_overproduction: NCBI explicitly states that PAP reflects decreased surfactant clearance rather than increased surfactant production.
claim_audit.imaging: Ground-glass opacities with interlobular/intralobular septal thickening create a crazy-paving pattern that is suggestive but not specific for PAP.
claim_audit.lavage_pathology: Milky/opaque BAL with foamy macrophages and PAS-positive amorphous lipoproteinaceous material is characteristic.
claim_audit.gas_exchange: Alveolar surfactant accumulation impairs diffusion/gas exchange and can produce hypoxemia and restrictive physiology.
claim_audit.distractor_1: Type II pneumocyte hypersecretion is directly contradicted by the established decreased-clearance mechanism.
claim_audit.distractor_2: Axonemal dynein failure causes primary ciliary dyskinesia and mucociliary-clearance disease, not surfactant-rich alveolar filling.
claim_audit.distractor_3: NADPH oxidase deficiency causes chronic granulomatous disease; it does not explain anti-GM-CSF-associated surfactant accumulation.
claim_audit.distractor_4: Hydrostatic edema can produce diffuse opacities/crazy paving but not anti-GM-CSF antibodies with PAS-positive surfactant-rich BAL.
claim_audit.blueprint_claim: USMLE places gas-exchange/hypoxia and restrictive/structural respiratory disorders within Respiratory System and states examples in the content outline are not exhaustive.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Progressive hypoxemia plus ground-glass/septal thickening raises an alveolar-filling differential. Milky BAL and PAS-positive material point to PAP; anti-GM-CSF identifies the autoimmune form. The causal cellular defect is impaired GM-CSF-dependent alveolar macrophage surfactant clearance.
adversarial_second_pass.crazy_paving_challenge: Crazy paving is nonspecific and cannot alone determine PAP. The item deliberately adds BAL and serologic evidence so the diagnosis and mechanism do not rest on one radiologic clue.
adversarial_second_pass.secondary_pap_challenge: Secondary PAP can also result from dysfunctional macrophages, but high-titer anti-GM-CSF antibodies specifically support autoimmune PAP rather than secondary hematologic/immunodeficiency-associated PAP.
adversarial_second_pass.congenital_pap_challenge: Congenital PAP can involve GM-CSF receptor or surfactant-protein defects, but the adult presentation with anti-GM-CSF IgG identifies acquired autoimmune disease.
adversarial_second_pass.cgd_challenge: CGD impairs microbial killing and can predispose to pulmonary infection, but the biochemical/radiologic/BAL pattern in this vignette is surfactant accumulation, not granulomatous infection.
adversarial_second_pass.edema_challenge: Cardiogenic edema can mimic crazy paving but would not generate anti-GM-CSF antibodies or PAS-positive lipoproteinaceous surfactant material.
adversarial_second_pass.cueing_check: The correct option is a cellular process parallel in style to the four alternative cellular/physiologic mechanisms and is not uniquely long.
adversarial_second_pass.unsupported_precision_check: No antibody cutoff, disease prevalence, BAL sensitivity, DLCO threshold, or mandatory imaging distribution is used as a scoring dependency.
